tests.name: short_ascii_string
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 behaves correctly with short ASCII strings below the 32-byte threshold.

tests.name: long_ascii_string
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 handles long ASCII strings of 32 bytes or more using the optimized scan path.

tests.name: long_utf8_valid
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 correctly accepts long valid multi-byte UTF-8 sequences above 32 bytes.

tests.name: long_utf8_invalid_early
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 detects an invalid UTF-8 sequence early in a long string via the scan path.

tests.name: long_utf8_invalid_late
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 detects an invalid UTF-8 sequence late in a long string, ensuring fallback to bytewise scan from failure point.

tests.name: string_with_quotes_and_backslashes
tests.intent: Verify that scan_string_run correctly skips quotes, backslashes, and control characters in long strings without failing.

tests.name: exact_boundary_31_bytes
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 behaves correctly on strings of length 31, right below the optimization threshold.

tests.name: exact_boundary_32_bytes
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 behaves correctly on strings of length 32, exactly at the optimization threshold.

tests.name: exact_boundary_33_bytes
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 behaves correctly on strings of length 33, right above the optimization threshold.

tests.name: push_back_long_string
tests.intent: Verify push_back on json_document triggers check_utf8 for long strings correctly.

tests.name: insert_long_string
tests.intent: Verify insert operation on json_document triggers check_utf8 for long strings correctly.

tests.name: object_key_long
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 works correctly on long object keys (which are also checked for UTF-8 validity).

tests.name: object_key_invalid_long
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 catches invalid UTF-8 in long object keys.

tests.name: empty_string_check
tests.intent: Verify check_utf8 handles empty strings correctly without out-of-bounds reads.

tests.name: long_string_all_control_chars
tests.intent: Verify scan_string_run handles long strings consisting entirely of control characters (which stop the run and increment q).

tests.name: mixed_valid_multibyte_and_ascii_long
tests.intent: Verify long strings containing a mix of ASCII and multi-byte UTF-8 sequences are successfully validated.

tests.name: overlong_sequence_long_string
tests.intent: Verify detection of overlong UTF-8 sequences in long strings.

tests.name: surrogate_sequence_long_string
tests.intent: Verify detection of UTF-16 surrogate halves in long strings via check_utf8.

tests.name: truncated_multibyte_long_string
tests.intent: Verify detection of truncated multi-byte sequences at the end of long strings.

tests.name: out_of_range_unicode_long_string
tests.intent: Verify detection of Unicode codepoints above U+10FFFF in long strings.
